exposure: CCL2 gene rs4586 (g.5974T>C) single nucleotide polymorphism
outcome: Chronic postsurgical pain (CPSP) 6 months after cesarean section
cohort: 350 Chinese Han women with CPSP 6 months after cesarean section and 350 healthy controls
finding: The CCL2 rs4586 T allele and CX3CL1 rs614230C allele were found to be protective factors for CPSP, while the CALCA rs3781719C allele was identified as a risk factor.
